data.title: 泽塔 · 午夜归巢的风衣
data.description: 午夜，泽塔翻窗落进据点的安全屋，风衣敞开，里面的战服被划开了几道口子。她坐在窗台上解开长靴，紫眸里带着任务完成的疲惫——今晚的情报，值这个价。
data.action: 坐在窗台上解开长靴，风衣敞开，战服破损，神情疲惫
data.lighting: midnight moonlight through the window and a small oil lamp
data.promptProse: Slipping in through the window at midnight, adult Zeta sits on the sill undoing her boots, trench coat open over her torn slime suit, mission done and eyes heavy.
data.animaCaption: Torn suit, priceless intel. Zeta kicks off her boots — the night's work is done.
